banner.text: We use Supabase to store your data securely. By continuing, you agree to our data usage.

collect.title: What We Collect
collect.desc: We collect information you provide when signing up, contacting us, or using our services. This includes your name, email, and account preferences.

use.title: How We Use It
use.desc: Your data is securely stored in Supabase and used to provide our services, send important updates, and improve your experience.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.desc: You have the right to access, update, or delete your personal data at any time.

essentialCookies.title: Essential Cookies
essentialCookies.desc: These are necessary for our site to work properly. They include authentication and session cookies. Always enabled.
